component.name: Tensela
component.summary: Diseño paramétrico que un arquitecto entiende

description.p: Tensela is a parametric design program for architects. A design is built with nodes joined by cables, lists with names and the language of the trade: say a tower has 24 floors and each one turns 6° more than the one below, and the whole tower appears; change one number and all of it answers.

Tensela es un programa de diseño paramétrico para arquitectos. El diseño se arma con nodos unidos por cables, listas con nombre y el lenguaje del oficio: dices que una torre tiene 24 pisos y que cada uno gira 6° más que el de abajo, y aparece la torre entera; cambias un número y toda responde.

ul.li: Facades and sun fins that open and close by distance or by sun
Fachadas y quiebrasoles que se abren y cierran según la distancia o el sol
Roofs and surfaces: hyperbolic paraboloids, ribs, grids and diagrids
Cubiertas y superficies: paraboloides hiperbólicos, costillas, retículas y diagrids
Hanging cables and membranes that find their own shape, and a first check of the bars
Cables y membranas que encuentran su forma, y una primera revisión de las barras
Sun and shadow for any place and date, sun hours and daylight
Sol y sombra para cualquier lugar y fecha, horas de sol y luz natural
Fabrication: sections, waffles and pieces laid flat on sheets with their numbers
Fabricación: secciones, waffles y piezas acostadas en planchas con sus números
Files for your CAD, BIM, renderer, laser cutter or 3D printer: OBJ, STL, 3MF, DXF, SVG and PDF
Archivos para tu CAD, BIM, renderizador, cortadora láser o impresora 3D: OBJ, STL, 3MF, DXF, SVG y PDF

description.p: It works entirely on your computer, without an account or internet, in English and Spanish, and comes with a complete manual with recipes explained step by step.
Funciona completamente en tu computadora, sin cuenta ni internet, en español e inglés, y trae un manual completo con recetas explicadas paso a paso.

screenshot.caption: A tower whose floors turn, with the seven nodes that make it
Una torre cuyos pisos giran, con los siete nodos que la arman
Sun fins that turn near a point
Quiebrasoles que giran cerca de un punto

description.p: Opens its window in seconds also on computers without a graphics card, where it took close to a minute.
Opens its window also on systems without a desktop (a bare X11 session), which lack two libraries of the keyboard: it brings its own, used only when they are missing.
Its launcher now passes the checks of older systems, such as Ubuntu 22.04.
The first update of the beta.

ul.li: Starts with the light theme when the desktop does not ask for the dark one
Comes with its description for the software centres of Linux
